ARABIC LANGUAGE — MOCK EXAM #20
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: ARABIC LANGUAGE
TIME ALLOWED: 90 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 80
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A girl asks another girl maa ismuki? What is she asking? (1 mark)
   A. How are you?
   B. What is your name?
   C. Who is this?
   D. Where is the book?

2. How is the Arabic word صَبَاحُ الْخَيْرِ read aloud in English letters? (1 mark)
   A. as-salaamu ʿalaykum
   B. sabaahu l-khayr
   C. anaa bi-khayr
   D. marhaban

3. How do you ask a boy how old he is? (1 mark)
   A. kam ʿumruka?
   B. kayfa haaluka?
   C. ayna l-kitaab?
   D. maa ismuka?

4. What does the Arabic sentence أُخْتِي تَقْرَأُ mean? (1 mark)
   A. This is my mother.
   B. My sister reads.
   C. This is my father.
   D. I have a brother and a sister.

5. Which question do you ask when you point to a boy and want to know who he is? (1 mark)
   A. maa ismuka?
   B. man haadhihi?
   C. kayfa haaluka?
   D. man haadhaa?

6. How is the Arabic word جَدٌّ read aloud in English letters? (1 mark)
   A. jadd
   B. ukht
   C. bint
   D. ʿamma

7. What does the Arabic word فِي (fii) mean? (1 mark)
   A. under
   B. above
   C. in
   D. behind

8. Which Arabic word means "sit down"? (1 mark)
   A. اِقْرَأْ
   B. اِسْمَعْ
   C. افْتَحِ الْبَابَ
   D. اجْلِسْ

9. What does the Arabic sentence عِيدُ مِيلَادٍ سَعِيدٌ mean? (1 mark)
   A. Blessed festival (Happy Eid).
   B. Do you have a party? (to a boy)
   C. May you be well every year.
   D. Happy birthday.

10. What does the Arabic sentence أَشْرَبُ الْمَاءَ mean? (1 mark)
   A. I eat bread.
   B. I drink water.
   C. I like bananas.
   D. I like juice.

11. What does the Arabic sentence أَشْرَبُ الْحَلِيبَ mean? (1 mark)
   A. I drink water.
   B. I drink milk.
   C. I like bananas.
   D. I eat bread.

12. What does the Arabic sentence هَذَا رَأْسِي mean? (1 mark)
   A. I smell with my nose.
   B. I see with my eye.
   C. This is my head.
   D. I hear with my ear.

13. What does the Arabic word قَلْبٌ (qalb) mean? (1 mark)
   A. face
   B. finger
   C. stomach
   D. heart

14. What does the Arabic word نَهْرٌ (nahr) mean? (1 mark)
   A. hot
   B. river
   C. mountain
   D. cold

15. Which sound does the Arabic letter ز make? (1 mark)
   A. k as in kite
   B. j as in jug
   C. z as in zebra
   D. t as in tap

16. What do the two little strokes at the end of شُكْرًا (shukran) create? (1 mark)
   A. The sound -un
   B. The sound -an
   C. A long ii
   D. The sound -in

17. Which sound does the Arabic letter ذ make? (1 mark)
   A. k as in kite
   B. b as in bag
   C. sh as in shop
   D. dh as in this

18. What does the Arabic sentence أَخِي صَغِيرٌ mean? (1 mark)
   A. My brother is small.
   B. My grandfather is old (big in age).
   C. Hello, Ahmad.
   D. My sister is beautiful.

19. Which Arabic word means "mother's sister"? (1 mark)
   A. أَبٌ
   B. جَدَّةٌ
   C. أُسْرَةٌ
   D. خَالَةٌ

20. What is meant by reading pace? (1 mark)
   A. How fast or slow you read
   B. How tidy your writing is
   C. How many books you read
   D. How loud you read

21. What does the Arabic sentence فَوْقَ الطَّاوِلَةِ بَالُونٌ mean? (1 mark)
   A. Above the table there is a balloon.
   B. The friends are at the party.
   C. This is a party.
   D. On the table there is a cake.

22. What does the Arabic sentence الْمَاءُ مُفِيدٌ mean? (1 mark)
   A. Water is useful (good for you).
   B. The juice is cold.
   C. The fish is delicious.
   D. I like food.

23. How is the Arabic word أَمَامَ read aloud in English letters? (1 mark)
   A. taHta
   B. amaama
   C. fii
   D. ʿinda

24. What is the name of the Arabic letter ص? (1 mark)
   A. ghayn
   B. Taa
   C. Saad
   D. nuun

25. Which sound does the Arabic letter د make? (1 mark)
   A. f as in fan
   B. s as in sun
   C. d as in dog
   D. m as in mat

26. Where should you write the Arabic name of a drawing? (1 mark)
   A. Inside the drawing
   B. In the margin from left to right
   C. Under the drawing, from right to left
   D. Only on the back

27. How many letters are in السبت (as-sabt) including alif and laam? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 6
   C. 3
   D. 5

28. Which Arabic sentence means "We dance." (1 mark)
   A. نَحْنُ نَرْقُصُ
   B. أُمِّي تَطْبُخُ الطَّعَامَ
   C. عِنْدِي هَدِيَّةٌ
   D. أَنَا أُحِبُّ الْحَفْلَةَ

29. What does the Arabic word هَدِيَّةٌ (hadiyya) mean? (1 mark)
   A. gift
   B. drink
   C. no
   D. cake

30. What does aghsilu wajhii mean? (1 mark)
   A. My head is big.
   B. I wash my face.
   C. I clean my teeth.
   D. I write with my hand.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
31. Explain why we should show respect when we greet people of a different gender or culture. (3 marks) (3 marks)

32. Translate into English: at-taawilatu Sagiira (2 marks)

33. Give the steps for reading a new Arabic word. (3 marks) (3 marks)

34. Translate into English: al-kursiyyu ʿinda l-baab (2 marks)

35. Translate into English: anaa tilmiidh (2 marks)

36. Describe how to solve a jumbled sentence. (3 marks) (3 marks)

37. Sort these words into items and position words: kitaab, ʿalaa, taawila, taHta. (4 marks) (4 marks)

38. Translate into English: atakallamu bi-famii (2 marks)

39. Describe three ways to work out the meaning of an unfamiliar word. (3 marks) (3 marks)

40. Translate into English: kayfa haaluki? (2 marks)

41. List four theme words about the home in Arabic (English letters), with meanings. (4 marks) (4 marks)

42. Translate into English: fii l-usbuuʿi sabʿatu ayyaam (2 marks)

43. Translate into English: fawqa t-taawilati baaluun (2 marks)

44. Give three questions you could ask when you give peer feedback on a friend's fluency. (3 marks) (3 marks)

45. Translate into English: al-jawwu baarid (2 marks)

46. Translate into English: al-yawmu yawmu l-khamiis (2 marks)

47. Write the seven days in Arabic sounds and say what the first five names come from. (5 marks) (5 marks)

48. Write four Arabic celebration words in English letters with their meanings. (4 marks) (4 marks)
pages.answers:
ARABIC LANGUAGE — MOCK EXAM #20 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. B — What is your name?
   maa ismuki? asks a girl for her name. The ending -ki is used for a girl.

2. B — sabaahu l-khayr
   صَبَاحُ الْخَيْرِ is read sabaahu l-khayr and means good morning.

3. A — kam ʿumruka?
   kam means 'how many' and ʿumruka means 'your age', so kam ʿumruka? asks 'How old are you?'.

4. B — My sister reads.
   أُخْتِي تَقْرَأُ (ukhtii taqraʾu) means: My sister reads.

5. D — man haadhaa?
   haadhaa means 'this' for a boy or man. haadhihi is used for a girl or woman.

6. A — jadd
   جَدٌّ is read jadd and means grandfather.

7. C — in
   فِي (fii) means in.

8. D — اجْلِسْ
   اجْلِسْ (ijlis) means sit down.

9. D — Happy birthday.
   عِيدُ مِيلَادٍ سَعِيدٌ (ʿiid miilaad saʿiid) means: Happy birthday.

10. B — I drink water.
   أَشْرَبُ الْمَاءَ (ashrabu l-maa'a) means: I drink water.

11. B — I drink milk.
   أَشْرَبُ الْحَلِيبَ (ashrabu l-haliiba) means: I drink milk.

12. C — This is my head.
   هَذَا رَأْسِي (haadhaa raʾsii) means: This is my head.

13. D — heart
   قَلْبٌ (qalb) means heart.

14. B — river
   نَهْرٌ (nahr) means river.

15. C — z as in zebra
   The letter ز makes the sound z as in zebra.

16. B — The sound -an
   The double fatHa (tanwiin) gives the sound -an at the end of the word.

17. D — dh as in this
   The letter ذ makes the sound dh as in this.

18. A — My brother is small.
   أَخِي صَغِيرٌ (akhii Sagiir) means: My brother is small.

19. D — خَالَةٌ
   خَالَةٌ (khaala) means mother's sister.

20. A — How fast or slow you read
   Pace is the speed of reading.

21. A — Above the table there is a balloon.
   فَوْقَ الطَّاوِلَةِ بَالُونٌ (fawqa t-taawilati baaluun) means: Above the table there is a balloon.

22. A — Water is useful (good for you).
   الْمَاءُ مُفِيدٌ (al-maa'u mufiid) means: Water is useful (good for you).

23. B — amaama
   أَمَامَ is read amaama and means in front of.

24. C — Saad
   The letter ص is called Saad.

25. C — d as in dog
   The letter د makes the sound d as in dog.

26. C — Under the drawing, from right to left
   Labels are written neatly from right to left.

27. D — 5
   The letters are alif, laam, siin, baa and taa.

28. A — نَحْنُ نَرْقُصُ
   نَحْنُ نَرْقُصُ (nahnu narqusu) means: We dance.

29. A — gift
   هَدِيَّةٌ (hadiyya) means gift.

30. B — I wash my face.
   aghsilu means I wash and wajhii means my face.

SECTION B
----
31. (3 marks)
   Answer: Greeting customs can differ. Using polite words and a smile shows respect. Respect helps boys and girls, men and women to be treated equally and to live peacefully.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for customs differ, 1 mark for polite words, 1 mark for equality or peace.

32. (2 marks)
   Answer: The table is small.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

33. (3 marks)
   Answer: Look at each letter and its mark; read each syllable; blend the syllables and check that the word makes sense.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each step.

34. (2 marks)
   Answer: The chair is at the door.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

35. (2 marks)
   Answer: I am a pupil (boy).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

36. (3 marks)
   Answer: Find the word that names the item; find the position or describing word; put them together in the pattern and read aloud to check.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each step.

37. (4 marks)
   Answer: Items: kitaab (book), taawila (table). Position words: ʿalaa (on), taHta (under).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word placed correctly.

38. (2 marks)
   Answer: I speak with my mouth.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

39. (3 marks)
   Answer: Use the sentence around the word; use a picture or a word you know; look it up in a dictionary or ask.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each way.

40. (2 marks)
   Answer: How are you? (to a girl)
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

41. (4 marks)
   Answer: For example bayt (house), matbakh (kitchen), taawila (table), kursii (chair).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct word with meaning.

42. (2 marks)
   Answer: There are seven days in a week.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

43. (2 marks)
   Answer: Above the table there is a balloon.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

44. (3 marks)
   Answer: Were the words clear? Was the speed steady? Did the voice fall for statements and rise for questions?
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each suitable question.

45. (2 marks)
   Answer: The weather is cold.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

46. (2 marks)
   Answer: Today is Thursday.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

47. (5 marks)
   Answer: al-ahad, al-ithnayn, ath-thulaathaa', al-arbiʿaa', al-khamiis, al-jumuʿa, as-sabt. The first five come from the numbers one to five.
   Working / marking points: 3 marks for the days (2 for five or six, 1 for three or four) and 2 marks for the numbers clue.

48. (4 marks)
   Answer: For example ʿiid (festival), hafla (party), hadiyya (gift), kaʿka (cake).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct word with meaning.
